_readme: Main settings. setup copies this file to config/settings.json; edit that copy. Regex lists are Python regular expressions, case-insensitive (write \b as \\b). See docs/configuration.md.

candidate._readme: YOUR details. The signature is added under every cover letter. cvs: id -> file, relative to cv_root (the cvs/ folder by default). Describe when to use each CV in config/profile.md.
candidate.name: Your Name

_regions_readme: Countries to search, most important first. Built-in names: United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Ireland, United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Germany, France, Netherlands, Switzerland, Spain, Singapore, India, Saudi Arabia, Qatar. Any other country works too; add its cities to region_patterns so locations like 'Lisbon' are recognised.

searches._readme: boolean: LinkedIn queries (support AND/OR/quotes/brackets), each run once per country. simple: plain keyword searches for the API sources (Reed, Adzuna, Jooble).
boolean: ("Graduate" OR "Junior") AND ("Data Analyst" OR "Business Analyst" OR "Operations Analyst")
("Business Development Analyst" OR "Commercial Analyst" OR "Pricing Analyst")
("Digital Transformation" OR "Process Improvement" OR "Automation") AND (Analyst OR Graduate OR Associate)

filters._readme: title_keep: a title must match one of these. title_exclude: and none of these. description_reject: groups of phrases that drop a job (a phrase is ignored when negated, e.g. 'no security clearance required'). max_years_experience: drop adverts that require more.

description_reject._readme_note: Each key is a reason shown in the triage file. Delete groups that do not apply to you; add your own (e.g. a language you do not speak: "fluent in german").
nationality: british citizens?(?:hip)?(?: only| is required| required)

flags._readme_note: Tags shown in the triage file. Give them points in triage.flag_points.
needs-long-term-rtw: right to work in the uk without (?:any )?(?:time )?restrictions?

dedupe._readme: A job with the same company + title + country as one seen in the last N days is a repost or a duplicate from another site.

triage._readme: Points used only to SORT the triage list; Claude still decides. See docs/configuration.md.
triage._salary_targets_readme: Your minimum gross salary per year. First match wins: currency, then optional region and optional location (a word in the job's location). Currencies read from adverts: GBP, USD, EUR, AED.

linkedin._readme: Public LinkedIn job search, no login. experience_levels: 1 internship, 2 entry, 3 associate, 4 mid-senior.

reed._readme: UK only. Needs a free API key from https://www.reed.co.uk/developers/jobseeker (put it in config/secrets.json), then set enabled to true.

adzuna._readme: UK, US, most of Europe, Canada, Australia, India, Singapore and more (not the UAE). Needs a free app_id + app_key from https://developer.adzuna.com (config/secrets.json).

jooble._readme: Aggregator in many countries (in the UAE it includes Bayt, GulfTalent...). Needs a free key: https://jooble.org/api/about (config/secrets.json). One host per country, e.g. uk.jooble.org, ae.jooble.org, de.jooble.org.

ats._readme: Employers' own job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workable, Workday, Teamtailor, Pinpoint, Oracle). No key needed. The employers are in config/companies.json. search_terms are used for the big boards (Workday, Oracle) that are searched instead of read in full.
